title: Classic-shaped ring, diamond-shiny, four original marks
desc: A classic round-bezel ring with a shiny diamond-like stone, in four original marks (Lantern, Flame, Oath star, Rising chevrons), each as a light-cut or a gold inlay.

takes.name: Lantern light-cut
takes.facts: mark cut into a diamond-gloss stone as light, ring of light in the bezel, dark emerald band; 8-facet domed stone (index 2.42); lights up frames 20-44, fades 170-188; turntable one turn per 200 frames

takes.name: Lantern gold inlay
takes.facts: raised gold mark with a glowing outline, polished silver band, gold rims; 8-facet domed stone (index 2.42); lights up frames 20-44, fades 170-188; turntable one turn per 200 frames
